title: Framework Artifact Taxonomy
purpose: Defines the normative artifact classes, authority roles, and ownership boundaries for repositories initialized from the framework.

artifact_classes.label: Discovery record
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Captures the problem framing, constraints, and early evidence that justify later planning.

artifact_classes.label: Product overview
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: States intended outcome, boundaries, and success conditions without becoming normative product authority.

artifact_classes.label: Implementation plan
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Coordinates work order and construction stages but cannot redefine accepted specifications.

artifact_classes.label: Repository specification
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Defines repository-generic requirements that all initialized repositories inherit.
artifact_classes.mutability: immutable once accepted except through governed revision

artifact_classes.label: Product specification
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Defines product-specific requirements and semantics for a repository derived from the framework, rooted under `specs/product/` and governed by the product manifest rather than the repository manifest.
artifact_classes.mutability: immutable once accepted except through governed revision

artifact_classes.label: Schema
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Validates repository-local structure but does not supersede the specification it constrains.
artifact_classes.mutability: immutable once accepted except through governed revision

artifact_classes.label: Manifest or index
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Lists authoritative entries and derived locations without granting authority to the listing itself.
artifact_classes.mutability: mutable only through governed registry updates

artifact_classes.label: Derived projection
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Must be reproducible from declared sources and must never override the source authority.

artifact_classes.label: Product artifact
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Realizes accepted product specifications but does not define their semantics.

artifact_classes.label: Test artifact
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Evaluates conformance or behavior but does not define product semantics unless an accepted specification assigns that role.

artifact_classes.label: Conformance artifact
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Records whether a product artifact conforms to an accepted specification without becoming the specification itself.

artifact_classes.label: Hosting-platform profile
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Captures provider-specific behavior and configuration without becoming portable framework authority.
artifact_classes.mutability: mutable within the governed profile boundary

artifact_classes.label: Validation evidence
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Documents the exact revision or state that was tested and the outcome observed.

artifact_classes.label: Review record
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Captures reviewer judgment about a proposed revision without itself becoming the accepted revision.

artifact_classes.label: Acceptance record
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Records acceptance of an exact proposed revision without authorizing unrelated successor work.

artifact_classes.label: Release record
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Records publication of an accepted revision and does not redefine the underlying specification.

artifact_classes.label: Hosting profile source
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Defines reusable hosting-platform profile source material under `profiles/` and may project installed adapters without granting them independent authority.

artifact_classes.label: Installed hosting adapter
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Mirrors a hosting profile into installed repository-local adapters such as `.github/` files without becoming the source of normative authority.

artifact_classes.label: Hosting deployment state
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Records remote branch protection, rulesets, required checks, merge queues, labels, and repository settings without becoming repository content.

artifact_classes.label: Bootstrap hosting infrastructure
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Supports current hosting-platform checks and policy behavior without becoming universal framework authority.

normative_requirements.text: The repository shall define exactly one canonical artifact taxonomy for framework-generic and repository-local artifact classes.
The taxonomy shall distinguish directional, planning, normative, generated, implementation, evidentiary, review, acceptance, release, and profile-specific authority categories.

The taxonomy shall state for each recognized class its role, authority category, authority source, source-of-truth rule, mutability, generation mode, validation ownership, portability category, and manifest participation.
An overview, plan, generated artifact, implementation artifact, validation evidence record, review record, acceptance record, or release record shall not claim normative specification authority.
Generated artifacts shall remain subordinate to declared source artifacts and shall not become semantic sources merely because they are materialized.
Framework-generic, product-specific, and profile-specific classes shall be distinguished, and profile-specific classes shall not be treated as universal framework authority.
Merge shall remain a revision event rather than an artifact class, and merge evidence shall not substitute for acceptance or release.

The taxonomy shall distinguish hosting-profile source artifacts, installed adapters, bootstrap infrastructure, and remote deployment-state evidence so repository-local profile mechanics remain separate from Git-generic authority.
Installed adapters shall remain subordinate to the profile source and shall not become semantic sources merely because they are materialized under `.github/`.
